commitments.statement: Every active repository remediation plan must explicitly disposition every repository-level surface tracked in the Pronto UI; evidence-backed completion leaves the active queue and remains visible in retained closures.

source.note: The user clarified that UI-plan parity is a fleet-wide invariant rather than a Pronto-only improvement.

commitments.statement: Repository remediation proceeds by preserving ownership and unpublished work, reconciling and stabilizing the canonical target, folding wanted work, verifying, publishing, then pruning proven redundancy and refreshing evidence.

source.note: The user approved making this order available to Pronto-guided agents.
